title: Executive Chairman and Councillors Sworn In
excerpt: Executive Chairman alongside five councillors took the oath of office before the Governor of Lagos State.
body: The newly elected Executive leadership of Badagry West LCDA was inaugurated to steer the grassroots governance and socioeconomic development of the council area.

title: Vice Chairman Sworn In
excerpt: The Vice Chairman took the oath of office following legislative clearance to oversee Works, Housing and Infrastructure.
body: In November 2025, the oath of office was administered following unanimous screening and legislative clearance by the Legislative Council.

title: Council Launches 100-Day Empowerment Drive
excerpt: Artisans received professional work tools, cash grants delivered to widows, the elderly and persons with disabilities.
body: Marking the first 100 days of the administration, a comprehensive social intervention programme delivered tools and grants across all five wards.
